_comment: HAND-MAINTAINED reference list — the sync reads this, it never writes it. The browse axis of the site: the six canonical impact areas plus one cross-cutting entry. `name` must match the option text of the `Impact area(s)` field in Airtable exactly. A tool or initiative with no impact area is filed under the entry marked `crossCutting`. Which tools, initiatives, countries and outcomes belong to an area is derived from the Live records, not stored here.

themes.name: Sustainable Fisheries
themes.tagline: Catch and effort monitoring, coastal surveillance, stock and fleet evidence
themes.description: Turning what fishers land and where they go into evidence that fisheries authorities can act on — from mobile reporting at landing sites through to national dashboards.

themes.name: Productive Aquaculture
themes.tagline: Pond management, feeds, genetics and extension
themes.description: Tools for smallholder fish farming: what to feed, when to harvest, which strain to stock, and how extension services reach the farmers who need that advice.

themes.name: Nutrition Security
themes.tagline: Nutrient composition, post-harvest loss, value chains
themes.description: Connecting what comes out of the water to what people actually eat — nutrient profiles, post-harvest handling, and the value chains in between.

themes.name: Climate Adaptation
themes.tagline: Climate information services, risk profiling, adaptive management
themes.description: Helping fishers and farmers plan against a shifting climate: risk profiles, adaptation options, and management that can change as conditions do.

themes.name: Resilient Livelihoods
themes.tagline: Incomes, equity and household resilience in aquatic food systems
themes.description: Work on the livelihoods that aquatic food systems support — income stability, equitable access, and the social dimensions of who benefits.

themes.name: Better Governance
themes.description: Evidence and systems that help institutions govern shared aquatic resources — policy inputs, co-management support, and the data underneath both.

themes.name: Shared Infrastructure
themes.tagline: Pipelines, models, standards and platforms reused across every area
themes.description: The layer underneath the rest of the portfolio: processing pipelines, models, ontologies and open platforms built once and reused. Work here rarely belongs to a single impact area, which is the point of it.
